newsitem.title: USA: CRI Liquidating says sells 11 mortgages.
newsitem.headline: CRI Liquidating says sells 11 mortgages.

text.p: CRI Liquidating REIT Inc said Friday it had sold 11 federally insured multifamily mortgage investments, generating proceeds of about $54.5 million or $1.79 a share.
The proceeds include long-term capital gains on a tax basis of about $14 million or 46 cents a share, the company, which is a real estate investment trust, said.
It expects to distribute the net proceeds to shareholders as part of the first quarter 1997 dividend, which is to be paid on March 31, it said.
The dividend declaration is subject to board approval, it said.

The company said its remaining assets consist primarily of equity holdings in three limited partnerships. It said it plans to sell those assets, distribute net proceds, if any, to shareholders, and dissolve the REIT during 1997.
The move is part of its business plan, it said.
